_help: Feats. Import this file on the Custom content page (Import file). Keys starting with _help are notes for you and are ignored on import. 'type' is origin, general, fighting-style or epic-boon.

feats._help: SIMPLEST FEAT: just text. Everything except id, name, type, description and repeatable is optional.
feats.name: Lucky Break
feats.description: Once per Long Rest, when you fail a saving throw, you can reroll it and must use the new roll.

feats._help: FEAT THAT GIVES SPELLS. A 'spell' effect means you always have that spell prepared. 'ability' is the spellcasting ability (str, dex, con, int, wis, cha). Use the spell's id (its name in lowercase with dashes: 'Misty Step' -> 'misty-step'). 'note' is shown next to the spell. A 'spell' choice lets the player pick spells from class lists.
feats.name: Wayfinder Adept
feats.description:
You gain the following benefits.
**Ability Score Increase.** Increase your Intelligence or Wisdom score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
**Path Magic.** You always have the Misty Step spell prepared and can cast it once without a spell slot per Long Rest.
**Hedge Trick.** You learn one cantrip of your choice from the Druid or Wizard spell list.

choices._help: +1 to one of the listed abilities (points = how many +1s).
choices.label: Ability Score Increase (+1)

choices._help: level 0 = cantrip. lists = class spell lists to choose from.
choices.label: One Druid or Wizard cantrip

feats._help: FEAT WITH SKILL PICKS AND A FLAT BONUS. 'expertise': true picks among skills the character is already proficient in. Other handy effects: initiativeBonus, speedBonus, darkvision, resistance, hpPerLevel, acBonus.
feats.name: Street Scholar
feats.description: You gain proficiency in two skills of your choice, Expertise in one skill you're proficient in, and a +2 bonus to Initiative.

feats._help: FEAT WITH AN ON/OFF STATE AND EXTRA DAMAGE. A 'toggle' shows a switch under Active effects; its effects only apply while it is on. 'resource' (optional) spends a use when switched on. A 'damageRider' adds a checkbox for extra damage on the sheet's attacks.
feats.name: Battle Trance
feats.description: As a Bonus Action you can enter a trance for 1 minute: you gain a +1 bonus to AC and your weapon hits can deal an extra 1d4 damage. You can do this a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus per Long Rest.

effects.label: Battle Trance
effects.description: +1 AC; weapon hits can deal an extra 1d4 damage.
